scope: Proposition 6.4 (The two-filtration structure) of the manuscript “The ordinary-double-point gap in every dimension” (preprints/The-ordinary-double-point-gap-in-every-dimension-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 037 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e2cdac4857afef7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 41. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The filtration W is multiplicative, with G = grW S ≃ D[v], degW v = 1, degW |D = T. (6.14) Here v is a regular polynomial variable of original degree m. Moreover HilbW G(z) = (1 − z)−n , deg ωG = (r, n). (6.15) The W-Rees space is a finite-type normal Gorenstein variety. Its canonical generator has bidegree (r, n − 1) and, on λ ̸= 0, is cλ−nΩC ∧ dλ.
